claim: The sample notebook is separate from real practice data, can be reset, and is discarded when the user starts for real.
where: home sample action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create real and sample cards; reset the sample; leave demo; assert only the real card remains

claim: The sample and saved practice cards work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context; load demo and add a card; wait for service worker; set context offline; reload and assert both sample and added cards

claim: The product includes an installable PWA shell.
sandbox: demo entry; parse the linked manifest and assert standalone display, app icons, start URL, and active service worker

claim: Repeated taps calculate a usable tempo.
sandbox: demo entry; make timed keyboard taps and assert the displayed BPM result

claim: Direct tempo input supports 30–240 BPM.
where: tempo controls, how it works, README
sandbox: demo entry; enter values below and above the range and assert 30 and 240

claim: The click supports an accented first beat in listed meters from 2/4 through 12/4.
where: tempo controls, how it works, README
sandbox: demo entry; select boundary meters, assert beat counts, start click, and assert the accented-beat status

claim: Click sounds are synthesized in the browser without microphone access or audio files; the product does not record, grade, host, or stream performances.
sandbox: demo entry; monitor media requests and microphone calls while starting and stopping the click; assert no recording or playback input exists

claim: Practice cards keep a name, starting BPM, passed BPM, next BPM, meter, and note.
sandbox: demo seed; assert the realistic sample card renders every promised field

claim: Passed and needs-work results have dated history.
sandbox: demo seed; open history and assert both outcomes and machine-readable dates

claim: Practice cards use local IndexedDB storage and persist across reloads.
sandbox: demo entry; record a result, assert the isolated IndexedDB exists, reload, and assert the changed card history remains

claim: Imported cards with matching IDs use the newest edit.
sandbox: demo seed; import older and newer versions of one card and assert only the newer edit wins

claim: The free edition exports every practice card in a JSON backup.
sandbox: demo seed; download JSON and assert all seeded cards and fields

claim: The free edition exports a CSV practice summary.
sandbox: demo seed; download CSV and assert the header and one row per seeded card

claim: Space taps tempo, M starts or stops the click, and Escape closes the card dialog.
sandbox: demo entry; exercise all three keys and assert their outcomes

claim: The free edition holds five practice cards.
sandbox: demo seed; add cards to five, attempt a sixth, and assert the limit without losing cards

claim: The free edition shows three history entries while JSON export keeps the complete history.
sandbox: demo seed with five attempts; assert three visible entries and five exported entries

claim: A $9 one-time purchase opens the registered hosted checkout and adds unlimited cards, complete on-screen history, and 1–24 BPM steps.
sandbox: demo entry plus live registered checkout; assert feature copy, Sociobot endpoint, hosted offer name, and $9 price

claim: Practice-card work and tempo settings stay in local browser storage and do not send practice data off the product origin.
sandbox: fresh demo context; change settings and record a result; assert namespaced local storage and only same-origin requests

claim: The product makes no analytics, advertising, third-party font, script, audio-file, or embedded payment-provider requests.
sandbox: demo flow; inspect all requested resource types and URLs; assert no payment iframe is embedded

claim: A cached license is checked at most once per day.
sandbox: demo license namespace with controlled verification response; reload and assert one request

claim: Click volume starts at 50% of its control.
sandbox: fresh demo context; compare the initial slider value with its maximum and visible value

claim: A user can delete a practice card and undo the deletion.
sandbox: demo seed; confirm deletion, assert removal, use Undo, and assert restoration

claim: A valid cached license remains available offline, while an invalid or revoked license returns the app to free limits.
sandbox: demo license namespace with controlled valid then invalid responses; reload offline; assert unlocked then free states

claim: The free tempo tool and practice notebook work without an account.
sandbox: fresh real notebook; monitor requests, create and reload a card without authentication fields or account traffic
